sections.title: 1. "N+1"-equivalent: linear scans masquerading as indexed lookups
2. Memory leaks (confirmed, not hypothetical)
3. Caching opportunities
4. Redundant computations
Summary — priority order
sections.content:
1. Fix `requestAgent` polling-without-timeout (base-agent.ts) — real hang/leak risk in production.
2. Add eviction to `StateManager.tasks` — unbounded growth, worst long-run leak.
3. Add cleanup/TTL to `HistoricalStore` (currently the only store of its kind with none).
4. Replace linear-scan `.search()` with a real index or at least batch/cache queries.
5. Memoize `recommendHashtags` and wire the existing `LRUCache` into `MonteCarloEngine`.
6. Single-pass grouping in `analytics.ts` instead of repeated filters.

No React-specific findings are possible since there's no frontend code in this repo — let me know if there's a separate UI codebase you want reviewed for re-renders.
